🚨🇪🇸 JUST IN - Pending Confirmation: Atlético Madrid’s plan is to sign Jorge Salinas once Matteo Ruggeri leaves for Aston Villa.

There is a possibility of including a player on loan as part of the deal.

Salinas was on the radar of several Premier League clubs, but the Atlético option appeals to him more.

@marqoss

replies.text: Salinas choosing Atleti over those PL options feels like a smart fit for their system, though the loan piece in the deal could go either way depending on who they send.
